mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) that can potentiate CNS depression from diazepam and increase sedation risk.
action: Monitor renal function and electrolytes closely; adjust diazepam dosing if renal impairment develops; ensure adequate potassium and magnesium supplementation during amphotericin B therapy.
